The main takeaway from our work is that

mindfulness practice may help to regulate emotional reactivity by reducing the intensity of emotional responses, and that this effect is mediated by different brain mechanisms depending on the level of experience in mindfulness practice.
mindfulness training can be beneficial in the treatment of mood disorders.
